opportunities.point: The company expects a top-line growth of around 25% to 30%.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So I expect top-line growth also to get maintained around 25% to 30%." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management expects same-store sales growth (SSG) to be around 25% to 30%.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "SSG, I am expecting around 25% to 30%, it will not be less than 25% to 30%." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company plans to add 15 new stores in a 24-month period, out of which one is already established.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Company has got plan to add 15 new stores which is mentioned, very well mentioned in DRHP, RHP, and prospectus, out of which one store is already established and overall this expansion of 15 stores will take place in a 24-month period." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Out of the 14 remaining stores, 6 to 7 will take place in the current financial year and the rest in the next financial year.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Out of these 14, 6 to 7 will take place in current financial year and remaining will be in next financial year." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: A consumer durables tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Diamonds are increasingly becoming relevant across occasions ranging from daily wear to weddings and gifting.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "We believe diamonds are increasingly becoming relevant across occasions ranging from daily wear and work wear to celebration, weddings, and gifting." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The Indian Gems and Jewellery Industry is projected to grow around INR15,000 billion by calendar year '29.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The Indian Gem and Jewellery Industry is a large and growing market, currently valued at approximately INR10,000 plus billion and projected to grow around INR15,000 billion by calendar year '29." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company has a current store count of 36 stores, consisting of two COCO stores and 34 SIS.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "With the current store count of 36 stores, out of which two are the COCO stores and 34 are SIS, we are evolving aspirations of modern consumers through a well-curated portfolio of natural diamond jewellery across price points." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The average order value for FY26 is INR1,20,000, registering a Y-o-Y growth of 41%.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "As far as current year ending for which we are referring the results, that is FY26, the average bill size value or average order value is INR1,20,000. Y-o-Y growth is 41%." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The expansion of 15 stores will take place over a 24-month period.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Company has got plan to add 15 new stores which is mentioned, very well mentioned in DRHP, RHP, and prospectus, out of which one store is already established and overall this expansion of 15 stores will take place in a 24-month period." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01) [next 2 years]

opportunities.point: Management stated a strategy centred on scaling the retail footprint through COCO stores, enhancing brand visibility, and expanding presence in high-potential markets.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Looking ahead, our strategy centres on scaling our retail footprint through COCO stores, enhancing brand visibility, and expanding our presence in high-potential markets." (concall ppt - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Continued promoter buying signals confidence in what is coming.
